tools.name: health
tools.description: Service health, storage mode, trackingTag status, and catalog count.

tools.name: list_marketplaces
tools.description: List supported Amazon storefronts (id, domain, defaultLocale). Prefer matching marketplace + locale to the end user. Until real Associates IDs are registered, links omit ?tag= (tagConfigured=false). Never invent placeholders.

tools.name: search_kit_items
tools.description: Search dorm / back-to-school essentials. Returns Amazon search deep-links (and optional catalog matches). marketplace + locale are REQUIRED. Until real Associates IDs exist, links omit ?tag= (tagConfigured=false).

tools.name: create_kit
tools.description: Create an empty or pre-filled dorm kit wishlist. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, roommateUrl. marketplace + locale REQUIRED.

tools.name: create_and_fill_kit
tools.description: One-shot: create a dorm kit and fill from itemQueries, itemKeywords, and/or itemAsins. marketplace + locale REQUIRED.

tools.name: add_kit_item
tools.description: Add an item to an existing dorm kit. Requires kit id and editToken from create_kit / create_and_fill_kit.

tools.name: resolve_product
tools.description: Resolve ASIN, Amazon URL, or keywords to a buy deep-link on the selected marketplace. marketplace + locale REQUIRED. amazon.se links include ?tag=sw-dormkit-21 when configured.
